@@ -0,0 +1,138 @@
+// Package tracing configures Flipt's trace provider and span exporters.
+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"net"
+	"net/url"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/jaeger"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracegrpc"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracehttp"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/zipkin"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/resource"
+	tracesdk "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace"
+	semconv "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.4.0"
+)
+
+func newResource(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*resource.Resource, error) {
+	return resource.New(ctx,
+		resource.WithSchemaURL(semconv.SchemaURL),
+		resource.WithAttributes(
+			semconv.ServiceNameKey.String("flipt"),
+			semconv.ServiceVersionKey.String(fliptVersion),
+		),
+		resource.WithFromEnv(),
+	)
+}
+
+// NewProvider creates a provider with Flipt's resource and always-on sampling.
+func NewProvider(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*tracesdk.TracerProvider, error) {
+	res, err := newResource(ctx, fliptVersion)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	return tracesdk.NewTracerProvider(
+		tracesdk.WithResource(res),
+		tracesdk.WithSampler(tracesdk.AlwaysSample()),
+	), nil
+}
+
+// GetExporter creates an exporter for cfg. Each call owns its exporter and shutdown.
+func GetExporter(ctx context.Context, cfg *config.TracingConfig) (tracesdk.SpanExporter, func(context.Context) error, error) {
+	if cfg == nil {
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("nil tracing configuration")
+	}
+
+	var (
+		exp tracesdk.SpanExporter
+		err error
+	)
+	switch cfg.Exporter {
+	case config.TracingJaeger:
+		exp, err = jaeger.New(jaeger.WithAgentEndpoint(
+			jaeger.WithAgentHost(cfg.Jaeger.Host),
+			jaeger.WithAgentPort(strconv.Itoa(cfg.Jaeger.Port)),
+		))
+	case config.TracingZipkin:
+		exp, err = zipkin.New(cfg.Zipkin.Endpoint)
+	case config.TracingOTLP:
+		var client otlptrace.Client
+		client, err = otlpClient(cfg.OTLP)
+		if err == nil {
+			exp, err = otlptrace.New(ctx, client)
+		}
+	default:
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported tracing exporter: %d", cfg.Exporter)
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, nil, err
+	}
+	return exp, exp.Shutdown, nil
+}
+
+func otlpClient(cfg config.OTLPTracingConfig) (otlptrace.Client, error) {
+	endpoint := cfg.Endpoint
+	if !strings.Contains(endpoint, "://") {
+		if err := validateHostPort(endpoint); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint %q: %w", endpoint, err)
+		}
+		return otlptracegrpc.NewClient(
+			otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint(endpoint),
+			otlptracegrpc.WithHeaders(cfg.Headers),
+			otlptracegrpc.WithInsecure(),
+		), nil
+	}
+
+	u, err := url.Parse(endpoint)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint %q: %w", endpoint, err)
+	}
+	if u.Hostname() == "" {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint %q: host is required", endpoint)
+	}
+	if u.User != nil || u.RawQuery != "" || u.Fragment != "" {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint %q: user info, query and fragment are unsupported", endpoint)
+	}
+	switch u.Scheme {
+	case "http", "https":
+		opts := []otlptracehttp.Option{
+			otlptracehttp.WithEndpoint(u.Host),
+			otlptracehttp.WithHeaders(cfg.Headers),
+		}
+		if u.Scheme == "http" {
+			opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithInsecure())
+		}
+		if u.Path != "" {
+			opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithURLPath(u.Path))
+		}
+		return otlptracehttp.NewClient(opts...), nil
+	case "grpc":
+		if u.Path != "" {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint %q: gRPC endpoint cannot include a path", endpoint)
+		}
+		return otlptracegrpc.NewClient(
+			otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint(u.Host),
+			otlptracegrpc.WithHeaders(cfg.Headers),
+			otlptracegrpc.WithInsecure(),
+		), nil
+	default:
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint %q: unsupported scheme %q", endpoint, u.Scheme)
+	}
+}
+
+func validateHostPort(endpoint string) error {
+	host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(endpoint)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if host == "" || port == "" {
+		return fmt.Errorf("host and port are required")
+	}
+	return nil
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,107 @@
+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/attribute"
+	tracesdk "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace"
+	semconv "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.4.0"
+)
+
+func TestResource(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "")
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", "")
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	res, err := newResource(ctx, "1.2.3")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	attrs := map[attribute.Key]attribute.Value{}
+	for _, a := range res.Attributes() {
+		attrs[a.Key] = a.Value
+	}
+	require.Equal(t, "flipt", attrs[semconv.ServiceNameKey].AsString())
+	require.Equal(t, "1.2.3", attrs[semconv.ServiceVersionKey].AsString())
+
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "custom")
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", "service.version=from-env,region=west")
+	res, err = newResource(ctx, "1.2.3")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	attrs = map[attribute.Key]attribute.Value{}
+	for _, a := range res.Attributes() {
+		attrs[a.Key] = a.Value
+	}
+	require.Equal(t, "custom", attrs[semconv.ServiceNameKey].AsString())
+	require.Equal(t, "from-env", attrs[semconv.ServiceVersionKey].AsString())
+	require.Equal(t, "west", attrs[attribute.Key("region")].AsString())
+}
+
+func TestNewProvider(t *testing.T) {
+	provider, err := NewProvider(context.Background(), "1.2.3")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer provider.Shutdown(context.Background())
+	_, span := provider.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "sampled")
+	require.True(t, span.SpanContext().IsSampled())
+	span.End()
+}
+
+func TestGetExporter(t *testing.T) {
+	cases := []struct {
+		name string
+		cfg  config.TracingConfig
+	}{
+		{"jaeger", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingJaeger, Jaeger: config.JaegerTracingConfig{Host: "localhost", Port: 6831}}},
+		{"zipkin", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingZipkin, Zipkin: config.ZipkinTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:9411/api/v2/spans"}}},
+		{"http", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:4317", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+		{"https", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "https://localhost:4317"}}},
+		{"grpc", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "grpc://localhost:4317"}}},
+		{"host-port", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "localhost:4317"}}},
+	}
+	for _, tc := range cases {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			exp, shutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &tc.cfg)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.NotNil(t, exp)
+			require.NotNil(t, shutdown)
+			require.NoError(t, shutdown(context.Background()))
+		})
+	}
+	_, _, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &config.TracingConfig{})
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	require.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "unsupported tracing exporter:"))
+	_, _, err = GetExporter(context.Background(), &config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://[bad"}})
+	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "parsing otlp endpoint")
+
+	// A failed call must not affect a later valid configuration.
+	exp, shutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &cases[0].cfg)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NotNil(t, exp)
+	require.NoError(t, shutdown(context.Background()))
+}
+
+func TestOTLPHTTPHeaders(t *testing.T) {
+	var header, path string
+	srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		header, path = r.Header.Get("X-Test"), r.URL.Path
+		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
+	}))
+	defer srv.Close()
+
+	cfg := &config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{
+		Endpoint: srv.URL + "/custom/traces",
+		Headers:  map[string]string{"X-Test": "configured"},
+	}}
+	exp, shutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), cfg)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	provider := tracesdk.NewTracerProvider(tracesdk.WithSyncer(exp))
+	_, span := provider.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "request")
+	span.End()
+	require.NoError(t, provider.Shutdown(context.Background()))
+	require.NoError(t, shutdown(context.Background()))
+	require.Equal(t, "configured", header)
+	require.Equal(t, "/custom/traces", path)
+}
